value.rationale: The first move of a parameter-free normalized zeroth-order solver defines a natural fixed-length expected-progress functional. Its exact least-favorable direction drifts with anisotropy and yields a sharp sqrt(delta log(1/delta)) degradation relative to isotropic progress 2/pi; neither the raw variance nor the preexisting conditioning-dependent global bound supplies this constant and orientation. The fact provides a rigorous benchmark for startup preconditioner robustness without claiming a global convergence theorem.
